meta.source: https://inittasks.com stylesheet :root and its theme engine (ported from the app's src/lib/themeEngine.ts), read 2026-11-13

color.note: Eight of the app's 23 themes. github dark is the default (the stylesheet's :root); ayu light is what the site's [light] toggle and prefers-color-scheme: light switch to. The other themes are derived by the engine from eight base colours.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and app background: the terminal ground every surface sits on. `--bg` in the site's :root.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: demo panels, chat bubbles from the AI, keycap and chip fills, menus. In themes it is `bg` mixed 5% toward `text`.

tokens.name: panel-2
tokens.usage: A second step up from `panel`: hovered rows and nested panels. `bg` mixed 8% toward `text`.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text: task titles, body copy, headings set in `text`. On `bg` and `panel`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: the app's 'comment' colour. Checkboxes `[ ]`, counts, dates, `// meta` lines, nav links, footer. On `bg` and `panel`. Source pairs under 4.5:1, kept exact: github-dark on panel 4.2:1; ayu-light on panel 4.2:1; catppuccin-mocha on panel 4.1:1; dracula on panel 3.9:1; nord on panel 3.9:1; tokyo-night on panel 4.2:1….

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand green: prompts (`$`, `>`), the cursor block, ticked `[✓]`, active nav, links on hover, `[ok]`, primary button text. On `bg` and `panel`. Source pairs under 4.5:1, kept exact: ayu-light on bg 1.8:1; ayu-light on panel 1.7:1.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: Accent at low strength: hover borders on ghost buttons, chips and keycaps, the lit keycap border. `accent` mixed 30% toward `bg` in themes. Decorative only (3:1 not required).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `accent` fill (the active nav keycap). Picked by luminance: near-black on light accents, white on dark.

tokens.name: headers
tokens.usage: Headings and the wordmark: section titles like 'today 4', `.hdr` labels, the brand name, highlighted words in the hero. On `bg` and `panel`. Source pairs under 4.5:1, kept exact: ayu-light on bg 2.8:1; ayu-light on panel 2.6:1; nord on panel 4.0:1.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings and dates that need attention: due dates, the 'now' milestone, `.tld`, the beta URL, star ratings. On `bg` and `panel`. Source pairs under 4.5:1, kept exact: ayu-light on bg 1.8:1; ayu-light on panel 1.7:1; github-light on panel 4.4:1.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Secondary highlight: project symbols and progress pies in the nav tree. On `bg` and `panel`. Source pairs under 4.5:1, kept exact: ayu-light on bg 2.2:1; ayu-light on panel 2.0:1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: boxes, panels, buttons, keycaps, the topbar rule, chips. 1px solid; keycaps add a 2px bottom.

tokens.name: border-dim
tokens.usage: Quieter hairlines: dashed dividers between spots and in the nav column, the footer status rule.

tokens.name: tree
tokens.usage: Tree connectors (├ └ │) between areas, projects and subprojects in the sidebar.

tokens.name: over
tokens.usage: Overdue and late: 'n days late', the overdue section header. Constant across every theme (the engine pins it). On `bg` and `panel`. Source pairs under 4.5:1, kept exact: ayu-light on bg 2.4:1; ayu-light on panel 2.3:1; github-light on bg 2.5:1; github-light on panel 2.3:1; nord on panel 4.3:1.

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: The AI's voice in chat transcripts (`.convo .ai`, the AI bubble's name). Not re-tinted by the theme engine. Source pairs under 4.5:1, kept exact: ayu-light on bg 2.4:1; ayu-light on panel 2.3:1; github-light on bg 2.5:1; github-light on panel 2.3:1; nord on panel 4.3:1.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Secondary warm accent in illustrations. Not re-tinted by the theme engine. Source pairs under 4.5:1, kept exact: ayu-light on bg 2.4:1; ayu-light on panel 2.3:1; github-light on bg 2.5:1; github-light on panel 2.3:1; nord on panel 4.3:1.

tokens.name: input-error
tokens.usage: Error border on form inputs (beta sign-up). Hard-coded in the stylesheet; not themed.

tokens.name: preset-red
tokens.usage: User colour preset 'red' for projects, areas and to-dos (`colorHex` in the API). Drawn as-is in every theme; a to-do's colour is a highlight behind its row.

styles.name: band-title
styles.usage: Band and section headlines, led by an accent `>`. Clamps 19–27px with the viewport on the site.
styles.sample: > one place for your tasks and your notes

styles.name: hero-lead
styles.usage: The hero statement; key words in `headers`.
styles.sample: a terminal-quiet task app with a second brain

styles.name: section-heading
styles.sample: > works with any ai that speaks mcp

styles.name: brand
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the mark, in `headers`.

styles.name: spot-title
styles.usage: Feature spot titles, led by an accent `>`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: capture now, sort later — a second brain, not just a checklist.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Nav links, bullets, benefits, buttons (at 600), box labels (at 600).

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Footer column heads and the status line.

styles.name: app
styles.usage: The app's own rows: tasks, the nav tree, meta. The apps render at mono 12.

styles.name: app-strong
styles.usage: Area and project names in the nav tree; section headers like 'today 4'.

spacing.note: The site sizes by hand in px, not on a scale; these are its recurring values.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Nav and tree row padding (2px 4px); swatch gaps in theme chips.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Task row vertical padding; bullet rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a task's checkbox and title; tree column gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Small gaps: key rows, hero facts; vertical padding of compact buttons and boxed lines.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Button padding-y and icon gap; checkbox-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Theme chip padding-x; nav column padding.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Topbar gap; demo panel padding (14px 16px); keyboard padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Button padding-x; demo panel padding-x.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Page gutter (.wrap 0 22px); box body padding-x.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between the text and demo columns of a feature spot.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: The blinking cursor block.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Swatches inside theme chips; the tail corner of chat bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Nav keycaps (.k) and the language switch.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Buttons, task rows, theme chips, keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-5
tokens.usage: Boxed single lines: the quick-add line, beta URL, menus.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Boxes ($ label), demo panels, chat transcripts.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles and the keyboard.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icons and the brand mark (a squircle-ish rounded square).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Progress pies and status dots.

shadow.note: The system is flat: borders, not shadows. One shadow exists, on popover menus.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Popover menus (the language switch) only.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the page column and the topbar.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Fixed topbar height; body top padding matches.

tokens.name: nav-column
tokens.usage: Sidebar column width in the app preview.
